title: clearfelt-writing routing manifest
description: Documents tests/fixtures/routing/manifest.json's shape, read by scripts/routing-eval.mjs. Same documentation-only role as schemas/qualitative-manifest.schema.json (not a validation engine this repo runs, see CLAUDE.md's dependency-free rule). Covers SKILL.md's Routing section, which command a request maps to, a model-judgment call (docs/decisions/0019), not something any script here can check with a regex.

id.description: Short stable identifier, e.g. "explicit-audit", used as the key in a recorded run's judgments object.

request.description: The user-facing request text a routing judgment is made against, verbatim.

expected.description: "menu" means SKILL.md's Routing section should show the Commands table rather than pick one command, either because no argument was given or because the request is genuinely ambiguous.
